findings.claim: Source mapping: the Sources block and sources.json cite "Dev.java: Calling Methods and Constructors" for "providing constructors and the default constructor". Re-fetched now, that page covers passing arguments, parameter types and varargs and never mentions a default constructor. The default-constructor statement is on the sibling page "Providing Constructors for your Classes" (dev.java/learn/language/oop/classes-objects/defining-constructors/). The claim itself is true (and also backed by JLS 8.8.9, which the page cites), so this is low.

evidence.section: Dev.java Providing Constructors for your Classes (the compiler provides a no-argument default constructor)
Dev.java Calling Methods and Constructors: whole page bytes (no default-constructor text)

findings.recommendation: Cite dev.java "Providing Constructors for your Classes" for the default constructor (page Sources block, artifact.md and sources.json), keeping "Calling Methods and Constructors" only for what it covers, or drop it.
